description: This script migrates email data from an old database schema to HTML files, creating directories, generating filenames, rendering email templates, and updating the database with file references. It also optionally uploads files to Amazon S3.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Handles file uploads, specifically to Amazon S3.

methods.name: View::get
methods.description: Renders email templates with provided data.

methods.name: File::factory
methods.description: Creates a file handler instance for uploading files.
